data.notes: September 2026 is already unusually busy for Antwerp, with arena pop, indie tours, folk legacy shows, a Trix metal date, and a sold-out industrial-hardcore night confirmed.

events.title: Emmylou Harris
events.summary: Emmylou Harris brings The European Farewell Tour to Stadsschouwburg Antwerpen, with Jim Lauderdale listed as support. The venue page confirms the 4 September 2026 date and 20:00 ticket listing.

events.title: Heresy Armageddon – The Final Ritual
events.summary: A sold-out industrial-hardcore gathering at Kavka Zappa with The Outside Agency, Innominate, Tymon, Deathmachine, DJIPE, SOVA, The Relic and Jeffius listed. Kavka confirms the 21:00–06:00 timing on Saturday 5 September.

events.title: Mac DeMarco
events.summary: Mac DeMarco plays two sold-out Antwerp-area outdoor shows at OLT Rivierenhof in Deurne on 7 and 8 September 2026. Live Nation lists Vicky Farewell among the other artists on the event.

events.title: All The Feelings Tour: Metric, Broken Social Scene and Stars
events.summary: Canadian indie acts Metric, Broken Social Scene and Stars bring their joint All The Feelings Tour to De Roma. Live Nation confirms Wednesday 16 September 2026, with doors at 19:15 and show at 20:00.

events.title: The Pussycat Dolls – PCD Forever Tour
events.summary: The Pussycat Dolls bring the PCD Forever Tour to AFAS Dome with Lil' Kim listed as special guest. The arena confirms Friday 18 September 2026 and doors at 18:30.

events.title: Sean Koch
events.summary: South African surf-folk artist Sean Koch plays Kavka Oudaan as part of a September–October 2026 European tour. Kavka confirms Tuesday 22 September, 19:00.

events.title: Beyond The Black – Rising High 2026
events.summary: Beyond The Black bring their Rising High European tour to Trix with SETYØURSAILS listed. Trix confirms the postponed Antwerp date for 25 September 2026 with doors at 18:30.

events.title: The Dublin Legends – 50 Years: Further Along the Road Tour
events.summary: The Dublin Legends bring Irish folk to Stadsschouwburg Antwerpen on their 50 Years: Further Along the Road Tour. The venue confirms Saturday 26 September 2026 with a 20:00 ticket listing.

events.title: Feestkroeg XXL – Oktoberfest
events.summary: Feestkroeg XXL turns AFAS Dome into an arena-scale Oktoberfest party, with Snollebollekes, Frans Bauer, Bart Kaëll, Jan Biggel, De Romeo's, DJ Maurice and more listed. The venue confirms Saturday 26 September 2026 at 19:45.

events.title: DICE
events.summary: Perth indie-rock band DICE plays Kavka Oudaan after building international momentum around Midnight Zoo and the WINGS EP. Kavka confirms Sunday 27 September, 19:00.

events.title: South Summit
events.summary: Australian band South Summit play Kavka Oudaan while touring Europe in support of RUN IT BACK. Kavka confirms Monday 28 September, 19:00–23:00.

events.title: Good Kid
events.summary: Toronto indie outfit Good Kid bring their high-energy pop-rock sound to Kavka Zappa. Kavka confirms Tuesday 29 September, 19:00–22:30.
